predecessors.name: Ottoman Empire
predecessors.text: "The Habsburgs conquered the Sanjak of Smederevo in 1717, during the 1716-1718 war"; the territory "south of the Sava and Danube, roughly the Sanjak of Smederevo"

successors.name: Pashalik of Belgrade
successors.text: the territory, "returned ... to Ottoman rule" by the Treaty of Belgrade, 18 September 1739

ledger.x: 21 July 1718: the Treaty of Passarowitz gives the Habsburgs the Sanjak of Smederevo, which they had conquered in 1717; Belgrade falls in August 1717.
18 September 1739: the Treaty of Belgrade returns the territory to the Ottomans; Habsburg rule ends and the second Great Migration of the Serbs follows.
18 September 1739: the kingdom "existed until the next Habsburg-Ottoman War (1737-1739)".

wars.name: Austro-Turkish War of 1716-1718
wars.outcome: The Habsburgs conquered the Sanjak of Smederevo in 1717; Passarowitz gave it to them on 21 July 1718.

wars.name: Austro-Turkish War of 1737-1739
wars.outcome: The Habsburgs lost the kingdom (and Orșova north of the Danube) at the Treaty of Belgrade, 18 September 1739.

certainty.note: The page gives no frontier; the southern limit (Morava, Ibar) is undescribed.
